Test archives for domain/archive.rs
  rar4.rar        RAR 4 (v29) archive with one file "VERSION" ("unrar-0.4.0"). Copied from the test data of the `unrar` crate (MIT).
  rar5.rar        RAR 5, made with `rar a -ma5 pak01_dir.vpk sub`
  rar5_solid.rar  RAR 5 solid, made with `rar a -ma5 -s pak01_dir.vpk sub`
The content of rar5*.rar is generated by `sample_vpk()` / `sample_text()` in the tests.
